narrative.overview: Isle is a restrained top-edge status object, not a phone mockup. Its opaque black capsule changes shape continuously while Isle Studio acts as a bright inspection bench.
keyCharacteristics: Exact capsule geometry and concentric clipping.

rules.name: The Contained Black Rule
rules.body: Pure black appears only inside continuously rounded island or player geometry; no square black chrome is permitted.

dos: Do preserve the exact island state dimensions and single continuous black silhouette.
Do test long text, missing art, pause, and progress endpoints on Studio's white canvas.
donts: Don't place black rectangular bars outside the rounded island or player shell.
Don't let Studio preview controls call the live media session.
